all.name: Exarch
all.note: Exarch (Major): buffs the HEAL TARGET (usually an ally) — team-side value outside the single-hero sim; self-heal uptime depends on heal cadence vs the 4s window

all.name: Pilow
all.note: Pilow (Major): reduces ENEMY damage output within a radius; the sim models damage taken by one modeled defender, not a team-wide output debuff with uptime

matchups.gameplan: Your window is early: force trades before their core completes, and do not coin-flip fights past the crossover. Riktor deals area damage — spread out so one cast can't catch the group.
They out-threaten you whenever the lane is not even: treat this as a farm-and-team lane, not a duel. Dekker deals area damage — spread out so one cast can't catch the group.
